## Historical audit

**Source:** S0220, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_1/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_189918915/trajectory.jsonl`. References below are JSONL lines; all observations were provided whole, so no split-observation offsets apply.

| Evidence | Observation and limit |
|---|---|
| Student request, line 1 | The explicit goal was to reconstruct a 341 × 512 indoor photograph with separate meshes and matched camera and framing. The reference image itself is not visible in this audit. The warehouse interpretation is inferred from the student’s program, not independently established. |
| Student response and execution, lines 3–4 | One nonempty program was submitted and executed. It specified multiple objects: architecture, two racks, repeated pallet loads, skylight and ceiling fixtures. Colored geometry approximated seams, wrapping and labels; emissive materials were assigned to named lights and glazing. Rack ties, braces, pallets and hangers were specified as parts, but their physical connections and visibility were not verified. No articulated subject pose is established. |
| Student response, line 3 | The program specified an elevated camera target, 28 mm lens and −18° roll, area lights, Cycles, exposure and glow. These are intended settings, not evidence that framing, lighting, materials or rendering matched the photograph. |
| Execution result, line 5 | Step 1 failed with `TimeoutExpired` after approximately 483 seconds; stdout and stderr were empty and image was null. There is no visible render, inspection, correction, successful build or final `DONE`. The outcome is a **technical interruption**, with reconstruction quality and any downstream submission unknown—not demonstrated algorithmic failure or partial visual correctness. |
| Session, line 2; complete provided trace, lines 1–5 | The student session reported zero tool calls. No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, input or adoption appears. Thus there is no evidence of teacher receipt or autonomous iterative exploration beyond generating and submitting the initial program. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a failed execution without an image cannot validate geometry or appearance, and iteration requires a completed render. Task-specific choices include dense repeated rack and cargo geometry, film-like bands and a rolled upward-looking camera. The large scene may have contributed to the timeout, but the empty logs do not identify whether construction, rendering or another stage caused it. Object placement, part contact, texture fidelity, camera and lighting issues remain unresolved hypotheses; neither the reference nor a result image is available for comparison.
